name: Scott Sivley
why: A real captioned head-and-shoulders portrait printed with the Herald's profile of him as a presidential candidate, taken in the year he was administrative vice-president. Sharp, well lit, looking at the camera.

src.label: Herald 69:47, 5 Apr 1994, p. 3, "SIVLEY: Candidate focuses on SGA experience"

name: Bert Blevins
why: A posed studio class portrait, front-facing and in focus, but the TopSCHOLAR scan of this volume is low resolution so the frame is only 106 by 130 pixels. No larger photograph of him was found; the volume's own SGA group photograph gives faces of about 18 pixels.
caption_quote: Bert K. Blevins III, Newburgh, Ind.
how_identified: Junior grid, left page: five columns by six rows, with the margin name list in blocks of five, one block per row. Blevins is the fifth and last name of the third block (Julie C. Ball, Kathy Ballard, Kathy Beasley, Gary Bickett, Bert K. Blevins III), so he is row three, column five. The block is alphabetical and its five names match the five faces in that row, whose sexes read female, female, female, male, male in the same order.

name: Chad Lewis
why: Quarantined crop, now sourced and confirmed. A newspaper halftone mugshot, so it is coarse, but it is a real front-facing portrait and the only photograph of him found.
caption_quote: Name: Chad Lewis Hometown: Scottsburg, Ind. Class: Junior Major: Accounting

src.label: Herald 73:50, 16 Apr 1998, p. 3, "Race for SGA vice presidency heats up"

how_identified: The vice-presidential race panel sets each candidate's data block immediately to the left of that candidate's photograph. The first block is Laura Hancock, sophomore, chemistry, followed by a woman's photograph; the second is Chad Lewis, junior, accounting, followed by this man's photograph. The column running beside this frame carries Lewis's own quotation, "Lewis said ...". Held against the page image, the quarantined crop is the same frame, matching in halftone banding, pose and the dark mark at the top left corner.

name: Ryan James
why: A large, well exposed working photograph of him at the university president's desk on the day he held the job, in shirt and tie taking a call. Not a portrait: he is in profile with his head down, and no front-facing frame of him was found. The scan is 4848 by 7167, so the frame is big and clean.
caption_quote: Nashville junior Ryan James switched roles with Meredith after winning the "President for A Day" raffle
how_identified: The caption names only two people, Meredith and James, and describes this scene as the moment they swapped roles; the man pictured is the young one seated at the desk. Meredith is separately pictured and captioned twice in the same issue, on this page rubbing his eyes in an economics class and again in a mugshot on p. 3, and is an older man in glasses who is plainly not this person.

name: Eric Griggs
why: Only 44 by 54 pixels, cut from a twelve-person group photograph in a low resolution scan, and that is the whole problem with it. Recorded because it is the only face of him found anywhere and the identification is firm. Front-facing and in focus for what it is.
caption_quote: Third Row: Melissa A. Maggard, Eric D. Griggs, Jennifer J. Jaggers
how_identified: Twelve faces, and the caption lists twelve names in rows of five, four and three. The five lowest faces are the first row, and its stated order runs male, male, female, female, male, matching them, with Huma Ahsan fourth. The remaining seven split into a rear group of three and a middle group of four. Griggs is the middle name of the three-name third row, and the middle face of the rear three is the only man among them, which is this one.

name: Jennifer Jaggers
why: Only 44 by 54 pixels, cut from a twelve-person group photograph in a low resolution scan. Kept because it is the only face of her found and she is clearly lit and smiling at the camera in it.
caption_quote: Third Row: Melissa A. Maggard, Eric D. Griggs, Jennifer J. Jaggers
how_identified: Same page and same photograph as Eric Griggs. Twelve faces against a caption of twelve names in rows of five, four and three. Jaggers is the last of the three names in the third row, and the rightmost of the three rearmost faces, a woman, which the caption's order requires.

name: Tom Springer
why: Only 44 by 54 pixels, cut from a twelve-person group photograph in a low resolution scan. The one face of him found. He is front-facing and unobstructed, which is why this frame was taken rather than the Baptist Student Union group on p. 190 of the same volume, where he stands further back.
caption_quote: Second Row: Nancy L. Rascoe, Mistianna Holcomb, Kathleen Young, Tom Springer
how_identified: Same photograph as Griggs and Jaggers. Of the seven faces left once the five-strong first row is accounted for, three sit highest and are the third row; the other four are the second row. Springer is the fourth and last name of the second row and the rightmost of those four, and the only man among them, which the caption's three women and one man requires.

name: Jeremy Sublett
why: A posed studio class portrait, front-facing, sharp and evenly lit. Small at 122 by 170 because the TopSCHOLAR scan of the volume is only about 816 pixels across a printed page, but far better than the alternative, which is a face of roughly 18 pixels in the 1993 volume's SGA group photograph.

src.label: 1994 Talisman, p. 70, Sigma Alpha Epsilon portraits

how_identified: The page carries eighteen names in one margin column, under the chapter headings Sigma Alpha Epsilon, Sigma Nu and Sigma Phi Epsilon, against eighteen portraits running left to right in rows of five, five, five and three. The counts match exactly and the short last row of three sits beside the last three names, which fixes the reading order. Sublett is the fifth name and so the fifth portrait, last in the first row. That this is the SGA treasurer and not a namesake rests on the 1993 Talisman index, which enters one Jeremy Sublett and cites him to p. 204, the volume's Student Government Association group photograph, as well as to p. 200.
note: Portrait comes from the 1994 volume; his recorded year of service is 1992-93.

name: Brandon Rucker
why: A posed studio class portrait, front-facing, sharp and evenly lit. Small at 116 by 164 only because the TopSCHOLAR scan runs about 816 pixels across a printed page. No other photograph of him was found.
how_identified: Poland Hall grid, five columns by six rows, with the margin names in blocks of five, one block per row. Rucker is the fourth name of the first block (Lisa Pile, Olivia Reed, Randy Richardson, Brandon Rucker, Chad Schneider), so row one, column four. The block's five names match the five faces and their sexes read female, female, male, male, male in that order.
identification_basis: Name and year. The 1994 Talisman index carries exactly one Brandon Rucker, a sophomore in 1993-94, which fits a term running to 1995-96, and SGA's own membership list for fall 1994 in this archive names Brandon T. Rucker as treasurer. No source found puts his portrait and an SGA office on the same page.

name: Jason L. Vincent
why: A posed studio class portrait in shirt, tie and sweater, front-facing and sharp. Small at 116 by 164 because of the scan resolution. No other photograph of him was found.
how_identified: Poland Hall grid, five columns by six rows, margin names in blocks of five, one block per row. Vincent is the second name of the fifth block (Ingrid Villar, Jason Vincent, John Whetstine, Michelle Whitaker, Stephanie Wiles), so row five, column two. The block's five names match the five faces and their sexes read female, male, male, female, female in that order.
identification_basis: Name and year. The caption gives no middle initial, and the archive's officer is Jason L. Vincent; SGA's own membership list for fall 1994 in this archive names Jason L. Vincent as secretary. The 1994 Talisman index carries one Jason Vincent, a junior in 1993-94 and so a senior in the year he held the office. No source found puts his portrait and the office on the same page, and the middle initial is not in the caption.

name: Stephanie McCarty
why: A posed studio class portrait, front-facing, sharp and evenly lit. Small at 120 by 162 because of the scan resolution. The only other frames of her are text-only newspaper columns.
how_identified: Poland Hall grid, five columns by six rows, margin names in blocks of five, one block per row. McCarty is the fourth name of the fourth block (Brent Martin, Deana Massey, Nicole Mattingly, Stephanie McCarty, Courtney McGowan), so row four, column four. The block's five names match the five faces and their sexes read male, female, female, female, female in that order.
identification_basis: Confirmed, not inferred from the name alone. The caption prints her home town as Eden, N.C., and the Herald's report of SGA's April 1996 year-end banquet, where she took the Dean Charles A. Keown Award, calls her a senior from Eden, N.C. SGA's own membership list for fall 1994 in this archive also carries Stephanie A. McCarty.

name: Andrea Wilson
why: A posed studio class portrait, front-facing, sharp and well lit, and she is smiling at the camera. Small at 118 by 169 because of the scan resolution, but the best frame of her that exists in these volumes.
how_identified: Grid of five columns by six rows, thirty portraits, with the margin names in six blocks of five, each block set beside its own row. Wilson is the fourth name of the third block (Katherine Stirsman, Mary A. Whalen, Diane Williams, Andrea Wilson, Nicole L. Zechella), so row three, column four. The chapter changes to Sigma Kappa only after the third block ends, which is where row four begins, so the blocks and rows keep step.
identification_basis: Confirmed, not inferred from the name alone. The caption prints her home town as Somerset, and the Herald of 5 April 1994, reporting her run for vice president on Scott Sivley's ticket, calls her a Somerset junior and the sitting SGA secretary. The Talisman caption gives the same class, junior, in the same year.

name: Erin Schepman
why: A posed studio class portrait, front-facing, sharp and evenly lit, smiling at the camera. Small at 128 by 167 because of the scan resolution. No other photograph of her was found.
how_identified: Grid of five columns by six rows, thirty portraits, with the margin names in six blocks of five, each block set beside its own row. Schepman is the first name of the fourth block (Erin A. Schepman, Jenny Sladek, Jennifer Smith, Jackie Stout, Andrea Wilkerson), so row four, column one. Her line sits level with the top of the fourth row of faces, and the blocks stay in step through the chapter change to Phi Mu inside the fifth block.
identification_basis: Name and year. The 1994 Talisman index carries exactly one Schepman, Erin A., a sophomore in 1993-94, which fits a record of service beginning that year. No source found puts her portrait and an SGA office on the same page.

name: Jason Loehr
why: A posed studio class portrait, front-facing and in focus. Casual rather than formal, since he sat for it in a baseball cap and fraternity sweatshirt, and small at 128 by 170 because of the scan resolution. It is the only photograph of him found.

src.label: 1994 Talisman, p. 66, Delta Tau Delta portraits

how_identified: Thirty names run down the margin under three chapter headings, Alpha Gamma Rho, Alpha Phi Omega and Delta Tau Delta, against thirty portraits in six rows of five, read left to right and straight through the headings. The counts match, and the sexes confirm the alignment row by row: row one reads male, male, male, female, female against McBrayer, Robinson, Spann, Kelly Ghent and Joni Kanzler, and row three reads female, male, male, male, male against Lauren White, Ayers, Ballard, Blevins and Brown. Loehr is the nineteenth name and so the nineteenth portrait, row four, column four.
identification_basis: Name and year. The 1994 Talisman index carries exactly one Loehr, Jason, a freshman in 1993-94, which fits a committee chairmanship in 1995-96. No source found puts his portrait and an SGA office on the same page.

name: Jason Embry
why: A posed studio class portrait, front-facing, sharp, well lit and smiling at the camera. Small at 124 by 172 because of the scan resolution. Far better than the alternative, a face of roughly 18 pixels in the 1993 volume's SGA group photograph.

src.label: 1994 Talisman, p. 69, Sigma Alpha Epsilon portraits

how_identified: Fifteen names in the margin in three blocks of five against fifteen portraits in three rows of five, each block set beside its own row. Embry is the fifth and last name of the first block (James E. Cliatt III, Christopher Crockett, Rich Depew, Robert Duke, Jason Scott Embry), so row one, column five.
identification_basis: Confirmed, not inferred from the name alone. The 1993 Talisman index enters one Jason Embry and cites him to p. 34 and p. 204, and p. 204 is that volume's Student Government Association group photograph, whose caption lists Jason Embry in its second row.
